name: vaadin-skills
description: Skills and tools for building high-quality Vaadin 25 applications with Java, Flow, and the Vaadin MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Style, build forms for, and test Vaadin 25 applications.
interface.longDescription: Vaadin Skills gives Codex focused guidance for Vaadin 25 development, including Aura theming, visual frontend design, Binder-based forms and validation, form layouts, and browser testing with TestBench. It also configures the Vaadin MCP server for current documentation and API lookup.
defaultPrompt: Build a form for this entity in Vaadin 25.
Style this Vaadin UI with the Aura theme.
Write end-to-end TestBench tests for this Vaadin view.
